record.paper_title: Some open problems in mutual stationarity involving inner model theory: a commentary.
record.context_brief: Mutual stationarity for a small increasing sequence of regular cardinals
record.original_question: Let ⟨λ_n | n < ω⟩ be an increasing sequence of regular cardinals such that infinitely many of the λ_n are not Mahlo, and let γ < λ_0 be regular. Using the same notion MS(⟨κ_α⟩_{α<δ}, λ) of mutual stationarity from Definition 1, what is the consistency strength of MS(⟨λ_n | n < ω⟩, γ)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Definitions. Given an ordinal δ and a sequence ⟨κ_α : α < δ⟩ of regular cardinals together with a regular cardinal λ < κ_0 (or λ ≤ κ_0 as appropriate), a sequence ⟨S_α : α < δ⟩ with each S_α ⊆ κ_α a stationary set concentrating on points of cofinality λ is called mutually stationary if for every algebra A on sup_α κ_α in a countable language there exists an elementary substructure N ≺ A with |N| = λ such that for every α < δ with κ_α ∈ N one has sup(N ∩ κ_α) ∈ S_α. Write MS(⟨κ_α : α < δ⟩, λ) for the statement that every sequence ⟨S_α : α < δ⟩ of stationary subsets S_α ⊆ κ_α ∩ Cof(λ) is mutually stationary.

Problem. Let ⟨λ_n : n < ω⟩ be a strictly increasing sequence of regular cardinals such that infinitely many of the λ_n are not Mahlo, and let γ < λ_0 be a regular cardinal. Determine the consistency strength (relative to ZFC, in terms of large cardinals) of the statement MS(⟨λ_n : n < ω⟩, γ).
artifact.category_tag: mutual stationarity and inner model theory
artifact.status_search_result: The exact consistency strength of mutual stationarity MS(⟨λ_n⟩, γ) for arbitrary increasing ω-sequences of regular cardinals with infinitely many non-Mahlo entries is not pinned down in the literature. Known results (Foreman–Magidor, Koepke, Welch, and others) provide upper and lower bounds in special cases (e.g., for ⟨ℵ_{n+3}⟩ inner models with many measurables are needed; existence of mutually stationary sequences at small ℵ_n is consistent from a measurable), but a precise determination in the generality stated remains open.

status_evidence.title: On the Strength of Mutual Stationarity
status_evidence.snippet: Studies consistency strength bounds for mutual stationarity at sequences of small regular cardinals.
status_evidence.claim: Lower bounds via inner model theory are established only in special cases.

status_evidence.title: Consistency strength results about mutual stationarity (Koepke talk)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses forcing MS at sequences like ℵ3, ℵ5, ℵ7,...
status_evidence.claim: Precise consistency strength for general non-Mahlo sequences is not determined.

status_evidence.title: Global square and mutual stationarity at the ℵ_n
status_evidence.snippet: Examines mutual stationarity principles at the ℵ_n.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results exist but the general question remains open.
